title: Secure first confirmed adopter
context: genome-browser-tracks defines success as delivered, not merged: a pack is shipped only when it is actually used by a beneficiary with externally verifiable evidence. Until a named adopter confirms they will use/adopt a specific pack, all tasks carry verifiedNeed: false. M1 requires at least one external adoption event recorded, which means following up on M0 outreach and converting at least one candidate into a confirmed adopter with a documented mechanism (hub URL in a repo, lesson plan, or registry listing).
objective: Convert at least one outreach candidate into a named confirmed adopter who commits to using a specific pack, document the adoption mechanism, and update affected task files to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set.
acceptanceCriteria: A named lab, educator, browser project, or advocacy org confirms they will use or adopt at least one pack.
The adoption mechanism is documented (hub URL referenced in their repo/notebook/paper, acceptance into a hub registry, integration into a course lesson, or fork/issue/PR referencing the pack).
The adoption is externally verifiable — self-reported use alone does not count.
The outcome is recorded in a committed document and the Steward's outcomes/<pack-id>.json is updated with the adoption evidence.
Affected task files are updated with verifiedNeed: true and requestor set to the adopter.
output: review/partner-013-adoption.md — committed document naming the confirmed adopter, adoption mechanism, and verifiable evidence; outcomes/ JSON updated.
